metrics.name: January 1 pooled rate
metrics.definition: Fresh steam in kg divided by output in tonnes across 5 assigned records, including any shutdown at 0 kg and 0 t.

metrics.name: January 1 simple batch average
metrics.definition: Sum of individual batch kg/t rates divided by the number of positive-output batches, with equal weight per batch.

metrics.name: January 1 pooled minus simple
metrics.definition: Difference of the two January 1 rates in kg/t. This subtraction has no numerator or denominator.

metrics.name: January 1 product L pooled rate
metrics.definition: Total fresh steam divided by total output for the 3 producing batch(es) of product L.

metrics.name: January 1 product H pooled rate
metrics.definition: Total fresh steam divided by total output for the 1 producing batch(es) of product H.

metrics.name: January 1 product H output share
metrics.definition: Product H tonnes divided by all positive output tonnes.

metrics.name: January 2 pooled rate
metrics.definition: Fresh steam in kg divided by output in tonnes across 4 assigned records, including any shutdown at 0 kg and 0 t.

metrics.name: January 2 simple batch average
metrics.definition: Sum of individual batch kg/t rates divided by the number of positive-output batches, with equal weight per batch.

metrics.name: January 2 pooled minus simple
metrics.definition: Difference of the two January 2 rates in kg/t. This subtraction has no numerator or denominator.

metrics.name: January 2 product L pooled rate
metrics.definition: Total fresh steam divided by total output for the 2 producing batch(es) of product L.

metrics.name: January 2 product H pooled rate
metrics.definition: Total fresh steam divided by total output for the 2 producing batch(es) of product H.

metrics.name: January 2 product H output share
metrics.definition: Product H tonnes divided by all positive output tonnes.

metrics.name: January 2 minus January 1 pooled rate
metrics.definition: Difference of daily pooled rates in kg/t. This subtraction has no numerator or denominator.
